name: original-motion-director
description: Original motion-graphics workflows with guided choices and voice-synchronized character performance.

interface.longDescription: Create original motion-graphics productions with guided creative choices, storyboards, character performance, voice and caption synchronization, and render quality checks. Built around urfavxbf/video-ai-editor. Reuses approved character assets and low-level effects without premade video templates. This skills-only plugin uses tools available in your ChatGPT or Codex session; it does not include a render server, voice models, paid compute, or character media. Rendering requires repository access, compatible tools and approved assets. Phoneme-accurate lip sync requires suitable mouth shapes or a rig and verification.
defaultPrompt: Plan an original UrFavXBF and PIX video and give me creative choices.
Help synchronize my final voice tracks, character animation, and captions.
Review my video preview for motion design, readability, and timing issues.
